crease_length_scale_t.basis: L* ≈ 200·t measured on Mylar (Lechenault 2014); paper unmeasured

tear_strain.basis: long bast fibres give high tear resistance (rsE §b) [E]

provenance.author: Innovaciones MADFAM
sources: Pliego research memo rsE (2026-10-10) §b material default table — engineering estimates [E] unless a source is cited
Baum, Habeger & Fleischman 1981, Measurement of the orthotropic elastic constants of paper — https://bioresources.cnr.ncsu.edu/resources/measurement-of-the-orthotropic-elastic-constants-of-paper/
Lechenault, Thiria & Adda-Bedia 2014, Mechanical response of a creased sheet, PRL 112, 244301 — https://arxiv.org/abs/1404.1243

heritage.place: Misumi (Hamada), Mino and Ogawa / Higashi-chichibu, Japan
heritage.makers: Washi-making communities of Misumi, Mino and Ogawa / Higashi-chichibu

claims.en: Washi craftsmanship was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2014.
claims.es: La elaboración artesanal del washi se inscribió en 2014 en la Lista Representativa del Patrimonio Cultural Inmaterial de la Humanidad de la UNESCO.

claims.en: It is practised in Misumi (Hamada), Mino and Ogawa / Higashi-chichibu and made from kozo fibre.
claims.es: Se practica en Misumi (Hamada), Mino y Ogawa / Higashi-chichibu, y se hace con fibra de kozo.

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: thin handmade kozo washi, rsE §b

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: handmade, near-isotropic; rsE §b [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: handmade sheet, near-isotropic: MD/CD ≈ 1.5 (rsE §b) [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981)

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: handmade, near-isotropic; rsE §b [E]; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: handmade sheet, near-isotropic: MD/CD ≈ 1.5 (rsE §b) [E]; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: L* ≈ 200·t measured on Mylar (Lechenault 2014); paper unmeasured

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: rest opening 27–43° after creasing (Lechenault 2014)

crease_set_rate.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.crease_set_rate)

score_factor.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.score_factor)

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented
